sessionCostTitle: Cost of this session (billed exactly at each call time)
sessionDetailCache: Cache: read {read} · write {write} (writes billed at the hit price)
sessionLine: This session {amount} · Hit {hitRate} · Input {input} · Cache {cache} · Output {output}
pricingCnyHint: CNY totals use USD prices × {rate}. To compare official CNY bills, select CNY, then sync prices; syncing affects only new calls.
reconcileLabel: Cross-check official balance changes against the local ledger (warn when they diverge)
todayCostTitle: Today's cost (billed exactly at official prices)
noHistory: No history yet. Once you start chatting, costs are aggregated here per day.
budgetDisabledNote: Enable a budget to see its limit, used amount and percentage in the display currency. Choose today, month, all time or a custom range.
balanceKeyHint: This Open Platform key takes priority; otherwise the signed-in official account balance is read, then model credentials.
tokenRhythmBalanceNote: Shows available CNY balance from the official account page. Sign in at tokenrhythm.studio. In browser DevTools, copy the account request Cookie from Network, or the tr_session value from Storage / Application. Save it below and enable this card. Cookies stay in the DSH credential store; replace them when expired.
aliyunBalanceNote: Shows Alibaba Cloud China funds. RAM AccessKey needs bss:DescribeBillingAccount. The first two fields are required; Security Token is for STS. Secrets stay in the credential store.
customBalanceConfigNote: Extract accepts paths, numbers and add/subtract/divide. Divide NewApi quota by 500000 for USD.
customBalanceUrlHint: Supports HTTPS, local HTTP and /plugins/… paths that follow the current DSH port.
customBalanceHttp: Allow non-loopback HTTP (plaintext credentials; requires the exact host:port in allowed hosts)
workBuddyBalanceNote: The WorkBuddy2API preset reads remaining credits across active accounts using an admin X-Admin-Token, not a model API key. Set the actual address and port; replace the credential when it expires.
customBalanceBodyNote: Blank sends no body; JSON text is saved and sent as entered. Content-Type defaults to application/json; headers can override it.
customBalanceConvert: Convert USD balance to display currency
customBalanceConvertNote: Uses the display rate and precision. Keep the source currency; other currencies and credits stay unchanged.
barDirectionsHint: Each group of bars can independently choose its fill direction: "Remaining" starts full and drains with usage; "Used" starts empty and fills up.
balanceBudgetCapHint: Leave empty to use API max_budget; if still missing, show full light-blue bar
customBalanceHeadersVarNote: {{VAR_NAME}} reads a credential or environment variable. <ROUTE>_API_KEY uses an uppercase Provider ID with underscores, such as openai→OPENAI_API_KEY. Names can share a key.
customBalanceAllowedHostsHint: When headers carry credentials only listed hosts are allowed; leave empty to allow with a warning. Protects keys when importing someone else's config.
customBalanceCredentialsHint: Store the key for each {{VAR}} placeholder above (write-only: stored in the DSH credential store, never echoed back):
customBalanceNoPlaceholders: No {{VAR}} placeholders in the headers yet — add e.g. "Authorization": "Bearer {{MY_API_KEY}}" and a credential input will appear here.
goQuotaKeyLabel: OpenCode Go API key (optional; empty = auto-detect)
credentialInputHint: The key is written to the DSH credential store only — it is never saved in the ledger and never echoed back.
secretMigrationPending: These credentials remain in the local ledger. Export the matching environment variables and restart:
minimaxOriginNote: Empty: official sites. Otherwise the Key is sent only to this origin. Use a trusted address without a path.
codexQuotaEnabled: Show Codex quota (requires a signed-in Codex plugin)
codexQuotaSidebar: Show Codex quota in sidebar (keep the conversation strip when hidden)
codingPlanDisplayNote: “Main sidebar / Both” shows a quota card; the narrow rail shows percentages.
quotaRefreshReady: Enable and save a display position to refresh
quotaSectionNote: Enabled items move to the top; click a name to expand its own settings. Up to 8 custom balances and 4 gateway sources.
codingPlanDisabledNote: Disabled. Enable it to query this vendor's coding plan quota on the refresh interval and show it here.
goQuotaDisabledNote: Enable OpenCode Go rolling 5h, weekly and monthly quotas in the sidebar, Settings and bottom-right corner. Missing subscriptions show a reason.
cornerEnabledLabel: Show OpenCode Go quota / budget at the bottom-right
peakOff: Peak/off-peak pricing is off; base prices are used
peakNotEffective: Not yet effective (effective at {time}); base prices are currently used
peakActive: Peak hour now; peak prices apply
peakNotice: DeepSeek peak-hour pricing is active; current calls are billed at peak prices
weekendAllOffPeak: Weekend — all off-peak (Sat & Sun billed at off-peak prices all day)
holidayAllOffPeak: Chinese public holiday — off-peak all day
weekendRuleNote: Since Aug 23, 2026 (Beijing time), weekends and Chinese public holidays are off-peak all day, including work-shift weekends.
peakAlertBody: Billing switches to {phase} pricing in about {time}; mind your call costs in this window.
peakAlertWebNotifyHint: When enabled, allow notification permission in the browser address bar so you get alerted even when the page is minimized or backgrounded.
peakNoticeHiddenHint: Notice hidden: enable peak/off-peak pricing and the “prominent notice” toggle.
sidebarSimpleNote: Condense cards but keep amounts, quotas and hover details. Height is capped at 38% of the viewport with scrolling. Turn off to restore.
sidebarSimpleBody: Simple display leaves more room for conversations. Enable it now? You can change it in Settings → Cost → Display anytime.
sidebarSimpleError: Settings could not be saved. Retry or dismiss this guide and change them later in Settings.
removePriceMatchHint: Remove clears the override and hides the row until restored. Usage records are kept; automatic price matching applies.
priceLockHint: You edited this price manually; auto-sync will not overwrite it.
modelStatsHitUnreportedTip: Zero cache hits on long calls may mean a relay removed cache fields. All-miss cost is an upper bound; check with the direct API.
modelStatsEmpty: No usage data for this period.
modelStatsNote: Hit rate = cache reads ÷ (reads + uncached input). “Unreported?” means cache data may be missing, so cost is an upper bound. Unit price = cost ÷ tokens × 1M; value = tokens ÷ cost.
sessionLineSplit: This session {amount} (API) · Plan equiv. {planAmount} · Hit {hitRate} · Input {input} · Cache {cache} · Output {output}
planStatsTitle: Token Plan usage stats (per-1% & full-window estimates)
planStatsEmpty: No Coding Plan quota data yet. Enable and refresh a provider under Quotas.
planStatsCurveTitle: Plan usage curves (aggregated from sample intervals)
planStatsCurveEmpty: Not enough samples: refresh successfully twice with a quota percentage change.
planStatsNote: Amounts are catalog-price equivalents. Plans use quota; budgets count API only. Estimates cover dsh calls, while server percentages cover the account. Short samples are less precise. 5h rolls; week/month use local dates.
catalogDisplayHint: Controls direct display in the price table; mounting and billing stay unchanged. Hidden cards stay reachable in the table.
priceTableDisplayHint: Expand a vendor group to edit prices; restore unmounted bundled models below.
priceMultiplyAll: Changing the multiplier applies to all rates for this model
priceMultiplySingle: Change this rate only; uncheck to restore the shared multiplier
priceMultiplyInvalid: Enter a non-negative rate or multiplication, e.g. 2 × 0.8
priceMatchNote: Manual overrides take priority. Auto-match accepts only the same name or date, version and context suffixes. Unknown DeepSeek models use the default price; other providers stay unpriced.
unmatchedHint: Set each channel and model separately: select a catalog entry, use a custom price, or mark as local. Custom prices apply only to that channel.
matchedHint: Currently matched automatically. Select a catalog entry, custom price or zero cost. Saved changes move to the manual list above; tokens still count.
cacheWriteFallback: Leave blank to use the cache-read price
opendesignNote: Using OpenDesign APIs in DSH does not require installing the OpenDesign app. Remote quota queries separately require an OpenDesign Cloud workspace ID and Control Key (not an inference API key); leave the quota card off to keep using conversation cost tracking without them. Plan windows and wallet stay separate. Public prices estimate Plan-equivalent cost; classify wallet-funded calls as API in billing settings.
qwenCliNote: Install @qianwenai/qianwen-cli on the DSH host and run qianwen auth login as the same OS user.
qwenBailianNote: Install bailian-cli on the DSH host. Login opens that host’s browser; for a remote or headless host, run bl auth login --console as the same OS user.
qwenPlanCreditsLabel: Monthly credits quota (personal Lite 50K / Standard 500K; see your plan page)
qwenPlanStartLabel: Plan start date (optional, YYYY-MM-DD; empty = calendar month)
qwenRatesLabel: Credits rate overrides (optional; credits deducted per 1M tokens; empty = built-in table)
qwenRateDraftNote: Enter all three positive rates to save automatically; clear all to restore the built-in table.
qwenLocalNote: Local Credits estimate; console is authoritative. Counts Plan calls assigned to Qwen. Excludes pay-as-you-go API. Add rates for other models.
scnetPlanCreditsLabel: Monthly credits quota for local estimates (Basic 60,000 / Standard 240,000 / Pro 600,000)
scnetPlanStartLabel: Plan start date (optional, YYYY-MM-DD; empty = calendar month)
scnetLocalNote: Uses console snapshots newer than 24h, then estimates from local records and official Credits rates. Other tools and unlisted models are excluded.
volcengineNote: Volcano Ark needs AK/SK, ArkReadOnlyAccess and BillingCenterReadOnlyAccess. Enter credentials or export VOLC_ACCESSKEY/VOLC_SECRETKEY. Only open.volcengineapi.com is contacted.
cardTotalSub: Since the ledger was created · Calls {calls}
externalStale: External snapshot has not been updated for 24 hours
cardsFootnote: Amounts use the latest snapshot and may lag the official bill by minutes. Tokens include input, output, cache and reasoning; reasoning is billed with output. Reconcile by amount.
timezoneHint: Today/month use host timezone {host}; this browser uses {browser}. Different day boundaries affect reconciliation. Set dsh to your local timezone to align.
historyExpandHint: Click a date row to expand its session details
historyNoSessions: No session details for this day (early data or session logs cleaned)
sessionRankHint: Days combined; subagents follow settings. Selected rows shown; cumulative costs include every conversation.
showSessionIdLabel: Show session IDs in session lists
cardsTogglePlanTotalHint: When on, every amount shows total equivalent cost including plan subscriptions; off (default) counts real-money API channels only
hideOfficialBalanceLabel: Hide official account balance (balance UI removed from sidebar and settings)
hideTodayCostLabel: Hide today's cost (today's amount removed from sidebar, budget details and overview card)
usageTotal: All-time {tokens} tokens · input {input} · cache {cache} · output {output} · {calls} calls
usageEmpty: No history yet — daily usage will accumulate here
quotaStripEnable: Enable the quota strip (one row above the input box)
quotaStripNote: Hover a chip for reset times and the last refresh; the strip hides itself when there is no quota data.
quotaStripGuideTitle: New: quota strip above the input
quotaStripGuideBody: Show budget and OpenCode Go/coding-plan percentages above the input box. Enable now? Change it anytime in Settings → Display.
balanceClickGuideTitle: New: click the balance box to refresh
balanceClickGuideBody: Click a sidebar balance or plan box to refresh. It pulses while loading; on failure it keeps the old value and shows the reason on hover.
peakNoticeLabel: Prominent notice during peak hours (sidebar budget box, today's cost; previewed in the Settings peak panel)
badgeNote: Session cost uses call-time prices, including peak and historical rates. Input, output, cache reads and writes are separate; configured cache-write and long-context rates apply.
pricingCurrencyNote: Selects the official pricing-page language. Synced prices apply to subsequent calls.
priceTableNote: Pro and Flash use separate official rates; legacy Flash names use Flash rates. Weekday peaks are 01–04 and 06–10 UTC; weekends and Chinese public holidays are off-peak. Rate changes apply to later calls. Recorded amounts remain until you confirm historical recalculation. Cache writes use hit rates.
datedPriceNote: Current rates are shown here. Editing cancels any future scheduled change for this entry; earlier historical rates are retained.
confirmFetch: Overwrite the price table with prices from the official docs?
syncScopeNote: Official sync updates DeepSeek prices (including peak rates). Third-party prices (z-ai/Kimi/Qwen/Volcano) follow releases; expand a vendor group in the price table or use model matching.
confirmImportLegacy: Confirm import? Replays all session logs and only fills dates/sessions missing from the ledger; existing records are untouched.
legacyImportNote: Pre-install history imports at first launch; rerun after copying old logs. Costs use current prices. Deleted logs cannot replay; sessions spanning installation exclude earlier usage.
